name: Lurching Throw
description: Send a small pulse of qi into the jab at the instant the knuckles meet the target.

name: Stubborn Fist
description: Harden the forearm with qi to stop a blow along the line of the punch.

name: Dire Grapple
description: Drop the weight through the front foot as the cross lands so the body adds to the hit.

name: Prowling Hip
description: Shuffle the feet a half pace back and forward to reset the stance after a flurry.

name: Rude Ulna
description: Drive a straight punch from the belly with qi gathered behind the fist to crack a guard.

name: Elbowslap
description: Loop a qi-charged hook to the temple that rings the head and dulls the opponent's footing.

name: Levering Knuckle
description: Bend the opponent's wrist back on itself and hold it until the arm gives way.

name: Ulnaprop
description: Extend the opponent's arm across the hip and press the elbow against the joint.

name: Tethering Elbow
description: Twist the arm up behind the back and lean on the shoulder to hold the opponent bent forward.

name: Stubborn Heelbone
description: Turn the trapped wrist out through the thumb gap to tear free of a grip.

name: Viselike Knee
description: Trap the opponent's elbow against the chest and roll the body to topple them.

name: Shoulder Hasp
description: Charge the hands with qi so their hold on the limb cannot be shaken loose.

name: Palm Prop
description: Release one lock as the opponent resists and flow into the next before they can recover.

name: Pulse Chokehold
description: Squat beneath the opponent's weight and drive up through the legs to unseat them.

name: Clinchhasp
description: Sweep the lead foot of a charging heavy opponent so their own weight drops them.

name: Viselike Sweep
description: Seize the belt and haul the opponent's waist forward to break their balance.

name: Palm Screen
description: Drive both elbows outward and drop the hips to burst a bear hug from behind.

name: Shard Shoulder
description: Lean back against a push and let it carry past before it finds the chest.

name: Gall Clinch
description: Root the feet with qi and heave the hip under the opponent to throw them over the shoulder.

name: Pinfall Thwack
description: Follow a rising knee at once with a downward elbow to the bent head.

name: Palmflog
description: Spin the held opponent on the hip and drive the knee into the exposed side.

name: Shinslap
description: Slash an elbow across the brow to open the guard for the inside work.

name: Ulna Barrier
description: Pin the opponent's striking hand against the chest and cover the face with the other arm.

name: Shielding Knuckle
description: Raise the knee outside the elbow to stop a thigh kick and collect a counter.

name: Heelbone Glide
description: Slide the rear foot beside the front to keep chest to chest with a backing opponent.

name: Fierce Throw
description: Drive three knees to the body at a steady beat with qi in the thighs to lift the opponent off the floor.

name: Sweepswat
description: Jab stiffened fingertips into the nerve cluster inside the upper arm to numb the hand.

name: Pulsesweep
description: Press a raised knuckle into the cleft of the outer thigh to buckle the leg.

name: Stalling Elbow
description: Pinch the tendons of the wrist with thumb and finger until the grip opens.

name: Harsh Clinch
description: Chop the side of the neck at the soft point beneath the ear.

name: Stalling Hip
description: Flick fingers toward the eyes to pull the guard up from the targeted point.

name: Pulse Shin
description: Brush an incoming wrist aside with the backs of the fingers.

name: Clayshin
description: Step in behind a covering forearm so the target point is reached before the guard can answer.

name: Knee Prop
description: Strike a nerve point with a pulse of qi so the numbness spreads along the limb.

name: Sprigthrow
description: Settle the chest across the opponent and add qi to the weight so they cannot lift.

name: Hum Shin
description: Drag the opponent over the shoulder to the ground and land on top.

name: Splice Chokehold
description: Cup the chin and turn the head against the shoulder to force a yield.

name: Sprigulna
description: Hook both feet inside the opponent's thighs and ride the back to steer them.

name: Poise Heelbone
description: Bridge sharply from the floor and tip the rider over the shoulder.

name: Sprigclinch
description: Let qi sink into the pinning arm so the opponent's struggle only tires them.

name: Bold Grapple
description: Throw a front kick and replant the same leg to throw a second before the opponent steps in.

name: Bold Knee
description: Hop the feet to switch legs and send the rear shin into the ribs.

name: Shinswat
description: Turn fully on the lead foot and whip the heel around into the side of the head.

name: Dire Sweep
description: Chop the shin low across the front of the opponent's thigh to wear the leg down.

name: Unmoving Shoulder
description: Hold the knee high to screen the belly while the foot is checked behind.

name: Throwhurdle
description: Snap the kicking leg back in under qi so the stance is whole again at once.

name: Hipthwack
description: Kick backward off a hop to meet a chasing opponent and gain the space to escape.

name: Grim Pinfall
description: String low, middle and high kicks at an even tempo that carries qi up the leg.

name: Stalwart Knuckle
description: Sink qi into the standing leg to hold the base against a sweep while the other leg works.

name: Gripping Clinch
description: Catch the punching arm and turn the body beneath it to throw the opponent past the hip.

name: Staticclinch
description: Step off the line of a rush and hook the passing ankle to drop the opponent.

name: Viselike Palm
description: Scoop up a kicking leg under the arm and drive the opponent to the floor.

name: Palmstalk
description: Pull the charging opponent's sleeve forward and step back so they stumble through the space.

name: Poise Shin
description: Plant the feet and turn the opponent's push sideways with both hands.

name: Rill Fist
description: Roll over the shoulder as a throw begins and come up facing the thrower.

name: Stout Fist
description: Draw qi to the center on a rushing opponent's first step to be ready to meet the weight.

name: Fistbarrier
description: Sweep the heel up through the opponent's ankle when their weight falls to the front foot.

name: Poise Knee
description: Slap a jab aside and return with the same hand to the opponent's cheek.

name: Draught Ulna
description: Lift the arm over a swinging hook and strike the exposed ribs.

name: Pulsefist
description: Wedge the palm between the opponent's arms and strike straight to the throat line.

name: Hum Fist
description: Scoop a low kick with the forearm and carry the leg away from the line.

name: Prowling Pinfall
description: Shift the guard hand and rear foot together to move the whole body off a charge.

name: Rushing Throw
description: Push qi through the palm into the chest so the blow travels deeper than the contact.

name: Fistcurl
description: Close the distance behind a jab and take the neck tie before the opponent resets.

name: Elbowscreen
description: Release the neck tie and hook the ankle in the same motion to drop the opponent.

name: Weighty Clinch
description: Cross the wrists in the collar and press the forearms inward against the neck.

name: Vaporhip
description: Break the opponent's grip and strike with the freed hand before they regain control.

name: Elbow Barrier
description: Spin around the opponent's hip and lock the arms around the waist from behind.

name: Throw Glide
description: Disengage from a ground struggle and come up on the feet with a guard raised.

name: Buttressed Shin
description: Run qi through the whole sequence so the breath and the hands stay joined.

name: Ember Chokehold
description: Cut the elbow across the face while the opponent still holds the neck tie.

name: Pulse Elbow
description: Seize the arm in a lock and throw the opponent over it so the joint takes the fall.

name: Humknee
description: Finish the lock chain with a throw that lands the opponent on the locked elbow.
